pr.title: fix(mcp): doctor must not FAIL remapped formula reserved ports
pr.body:
## Summary
- formula-only PORT_RESERVED_COLLISION is WARN when envrc ports already avoid reserved singletons
- configured reserved collisions stay FAIL
- doctor does not inspect a foreign cwd compose.yml when --repo is another path
- repo-aware start and default `mcp up` can interpolate compose.yml without a live bridge JWT when not starting compose task-orchestrator
- explicit `mcp up --services task-orchestrator` without DOPECON_BRIDGE_TOKEN stays fail-closed

## Authority
- TP-DMX-MCP-DOCTOR-FORMULA-RESERVED-001
- Observed dNh_CRM doctor FAIL + compose interpolation block

## Validation
- focused unit tests + compose token arch contract
- git diff --check

steps.task: Confirm formula reserved collisions are FAIL even when configured ports are remapped, and that compose.yml interpolates DOPECON_BRIDGE_TOKEN for every compose invocation.
validation: Root cause documented: diagnose_ports FAILs source=formula independently of remapped envrc; generate_mcp_env strips TOKEN keys so sidecar start cannot parse compose.yml without a process-env JWT.
